code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows significant hypoxemia, mild normocytic anemia, thrombocytopenia, and leukocyte differential abnormalities (relative neutropenia, lymphopenia, monocytosis, eosinophilia, basophilia). Electrolytes and renal/liver function are within normal limits except for mild hyperchloremia. Findings may suggest chronic hypoxia, possible bone marrow dysfunction or myelodysplasia, and increased risk of infection or bleeding. Clinical correlation and further hematological evaluation are recommended.
